topic: How does the hybrid SIW-waveguide feeding topology balance efficiency and compactness in V-band satellite antenna designs?
consensus_response: The hybrid SIW-waveguide feeding topology balances efficiency and compactness by replacing SIW power dividers with waveguide power dividers for larger arrays, mitigating insertion loss and maintaining high efficiency. This trade-off optimizes antenna performance, capacity, and reliability, while considering fabrication complexity and thermal management.
reference_context: Hybrid SIW-waveguide topology optimizes efficiency and compactness for V-band satellite antennas, with a wideband high-gain antenna design achieving 14.6% reflection coefficient bandwidth and 41% efficiency.
